name: Token of Thievery
summary: In the Redridge Mountains, rogues face a test set by Lucius at Alther's Mill. A locked footlocker holds the Token of Thievery, proof of skill recovered during their training.

sections.title: A Test of Finesse
sections.body: In Lakeshire, Lucius tests promising rogues in the field. He hides the Token of Thievery in a locked footlocker among the ruins of Alther's Mill, where Blackrock orcs threaten the area. Recovering it tests whether an initiate can pick a lock under mortal danger. Success earns a Certificate of Thievery.

faq.q: What is the Token of Thievery?
faq.answer: Lucius locks the Token of Thievery in a footlocker at Alther's Mill. Rogue initiates must pick its lock under danger to prove their skill.

faq.q: Who puts the token in the lockbox?
faq.answer: Lucius, an experienced rogue mentor in Lakeshire, puts the token in the footlocker as part of his training for young rogues.

faq.q: Why is the chest placed at Alther's Mill?
faq.answer: Alther's Mill lies up the road from Lakeshire, and prowling Blackrock orcs make it dangerous. Lucius sends trainees there to pick locks quickly and quietly in hostile territory.

faq.q: What do you receive in exchange for the token?
faq.answer: Returning the token to Lucius earns a rogue a Certificate of Thievery, recognizing their foundational training in lockpicking.

angles.text: As a rogue, you prove your skill with lockpicks by recovering the Token of Thievery from ruins threatened by Blackrock orcs.
